title: Your website is the first thing customers judge.
subtitle: Most local sites lose them within seconds, and nobody notices until the phone stops ringing.

items.title: Generic by default
items.text: Template sites look like everyone else’s and load slowly, so visitors leave before they read a word.

items.title: Hard to reach
items.text: No WhatsApp button and no clear next step. An interested visitor cannot contact you in one tap.

items.title: Built, then forgotten
items.text: Many agencies host a template for a year and vanish. You deserve real support after launch.
